# osmium tags-filter expressions for the swim.report layer build.
# Order is significant: osmium matches in the order given, so the most
# frequently matching expression goes first.
# Reference completion is ON BY DEFAULT. There is no -r flag (that belongs to
# osmium getid); the flag that would TURN IT OFF is -R / --omit-referenced and
# must NEVER be passed here — without referenced members, relation areas
# cannot be assembled and the six Great Lake polygons vanish.
nwr/natural=water
w/natural=coastline
nwr/natural=beach
nwr/leisure=beach_resort
wr/leisure=park
wr/leisure=nature_reserve
wr/boundary=protected_area
